cap: Preeclampsia is new hypertension after 20 weeks with proteinuria or organ injury, and any one severe feature, such as a pressure of 160/110 or higher, makes it severe. Treatment lowers the pressure, gives magnesium to prevent seizures and delivers the placenta. The kidneys clear magnesium, so toxicity shows as lost reflexes, then slowed breathing, and calcium gluconate reverses it.
